summary: Tested the family-pattern protection for members, admin, the AR/DE versions, the daily limit and the other calculators. Backend: protection suite 9/9 passes. New edge-case suite 6/7 passes (one bug, below). live e2e + family live 35/35 pass. test_api, blood_type, mendelian and carrier 54/54 pass. Member UI (Clerk ticket): the result card shows only GENOVA AI, the date, the GN-XXXXXXXX id, the Boy/Girl answer, the disclaimer and Print report. 3+3 child 1 shows 70–90% and child 2 shows 50–60%. Single child (wife B,B,G / husband B) shows Boy with no range. Not in table (wife B,G,G / husband B) shows '—' and 'No result is available for this combination.' None of these strings appeared: case #, Answer taken, Wife, Husband, review, Owner, engine, data version, Old App, reference. The form shows only the general traditional notice. The 'Which child' choice shows only for 3+3. Print media: #root is hidden and only the minimal report shows. On screen the report is hidden. History list items have no Wife/Husband summary, and History detail shows the public card. AR is RTL (html dir=rtl, report dir=rtl) and fully translated. DE is translated. When the count is set to 20, the UI shows the localized 429 message in calculator-error in DE and AR. API 429 messages are correct in en/ar/de. An admin is not limited even at count 25. Other calculators are not blocked when the family-pattern count is 20. Admin UI shows the full result: table case #75 with the borrowed source, Owner review notes, sources and engine/data versions. The admin print report shows the wife/husband families, the source and the limitations. The admin history list shows the Wife/Husband summary. No page errors.

minor.issue: A 3+3 request without child_number returns 400 child_number_required, but it still adds 1 to usage_daily. In api.py, _check_daily_limit runs $inc before fn(payload) raises GeneticsInputError. Members lose quota on input errors. Repro: test_family_pattern_limit_edges_live.py::test_error_does_not_count (count becomes 1, expected 0).

issues: In print emulation the report has no padding and sits on the edge of the page. The body's light-grey background shows below the white report area. Add padding / a white body background in @media print (minor).

action_items: Count against the daily limit only after the calculation succeeds. Either check the limit first and run $inc after fn(payload)/insert, or catch GeneticsInputError and undo the increment.
Optional: add padding and a white background to the print report in @media print.
critical_code_review_comments: api.py _check_daily_limit: increments before the calculation is validated (see the minor backend issue).

Protection is applied on the server in every read path: POST (including the dedupe branch), GET list and GET detail. /api/references filters internal refs. No secret table data was found in the frontend source except the admin-only rendering in ResultView/FamilyPatternReport, which uses data from the server only.

success_rate.backend: 98% (1 minor failure of 7 new edge-case tests; all other suites pass)

seed_data_creation: None. The 5 family-pattern analyses created in the UI for genova.tester were deleted. genova.tester's role was restored to member and its usage_daily count was restored to its original value of 1. The genova.ip test user's counters are reset by the as_role helper.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /tmp-style helpers built on tests/live_roles.py (_db, as_role, set_daily) for role and counter changes. Run pytest with -n 0. test_error_does_not_count is expected to fail until the limit-ordering fix lands. The UI was tested with Clerk tickets from scripts/clerk_test_session.py.
